# Copilot Instructions

This repository is used for comparative implementation runs in a project thesis.

## General Constraints

- Keep changes focused on the assigned GitHub issue only.
- Do not change public interfaces or function signatures unless the ticket explicitly requires it.
- Do not introduce new runtime dependencies.
- Follow the existing layered architecture: `presentation -> application -> domain`.

## Implementation Expectations

- Use the Python `logging` module for decision-relevant validation at DEBUG level.
- Add or update tests for every behavior change.
- Keep code and tests compatible with Python `>=3.10`.
- Preserve repository linting and formatting conventions.

## Pull Request Requirements

- Use the repository pull request template.
- Reference the GitHub issue and the linked Jira ticket.
- Explicitly map the PR text to the acceptance criteria by number.
- Mark AI-generated sections with `AI-generated by GitHub Copilot Coding Agent`.
- Include an `Open items` section if any deviation, ambiguity, or follow-up remains.
